findings.summary: Missing reviewed worktree ledger is silently ignored
findings.suggestion: Treat a missing reviewed worktree ledger as source_incomplete while allowing valid artifact relocation.
findings.reasoning: Observe: lines 376–379 return only for a missing base ledger and skip a worktree ledger. Trace: _source_snapshot omits a deleted ledger; _status receives no missing-source signal. Infer: an accepted review and enrolled task in a registered worktree can lose its ledger and return pending. Conclude: missing registered source is not reported, contrary to SPEC AC-001 and AC-005.
